Hello! I am **Calistus Mwanja Nyongesa**, a passionate Statistician, Statistical Researcher, and R Package Developer with an interest in statistical modelling, data analysis, visualization, and reproducible research using R.

I enjoy transforming data into meaningful insights and developing practical statistical solutions that support research and evidence-based decision-making.

## Education & Skills

**Education:** Bachelor of Science in Statistics, Kirinyaga University.

**Technical Skills:** R, Quarto, Excel, STATA, Statistical Analysis, Statistical Modelling, Data Visualization, Data Management, and Statistical Reporting.

## R Package Development

I am the **founder and developer of [rWaterKenya](https://github.com/Mwanja-collab/rWaterKenya)**, an open-source R package developed to provide accessible datasets for statistical analysis and research on water service providers in Kenya.

The package contains:

- **`water_data`** – Cross-sectional performance data covering 94 water service providers.

- **`water_panel_data`** – Panel data comprising 92 matched water service providers observed across two financial years.

Through this initiative, I aim to contribute to open-source statistical computing, promote reproducible research, and make locally relevant datasets accessible to researchers, students, and practitioners.

**Explore my software:** [rWaterKenya on GitHub](https://github.com/Mwanja-collab/rWaterKenya).

## Research Interests

My interests include statistical modelling, applied statistics, biostatistics, public health research, panel data analysis, and the application of statistical computing to real-world problems.

I am committed to continuous learning, research, and developing open-source tools that contribute to the wider statistical community.
